title: 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI Collision Repair
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair completed front-end collision repairs on a 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI after a hit-and-run incident.
story: This 2018 Volkswagen Golf GTI arrived at Carcis Autobody Repair following a hit-and-run collision. The impact damaged the front right side of the vehicle, affecting the front fender, headlight assembly, front bumper cover, and side mirror.

Technicians inspected the structure and marked repair procedures across the damaged panels. The repair required removing and reinstalling the front bumper cover and headlight to inspect underlying mounting points. The front right fender and mirror components were replaced and prepped for refinishing.

After fitting the replacement body panels and verifying alignment along the hood line, the team color-matched and sprayed the Metallic Dark Gray paint. The vehicle was fully reassembled and detailed prior to delivery.
